correctness.rationale: The proof computes the exact number of orthogonal restricted parity characters in each Walsh shell and sums a finite polynomial by a block-top-weight identity. The positivity argument excludes real eigenvalues on the bright reducing complement, so long-time capture follows rigorously independently of positive absorber strengths. The proof handles m=N and arbitrary nonempty blocks; 134 exact restriction-rank tests plus 30 independent Krylov-rank tests validate finite instances, not the all-parameter conclusion.

Product repetition codes have an intrinsic coding/transport motivation, and the formula distinguishes trap-count and geometry effects, enabling comparisons between structured physical multitrapping designs.
